concepts.name: 01-geography
concepts.title: География
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished logo concept presentation for a Russian independent forensic expertise and valuation company named exactly 'Все Экспертизы РФ'. Goal: laconic, credible, premium, businesslike, suitable for expert reports and a sophisticated website using serif headings and a navy/mint palette. Flat graphic design with crisp vector-like edges. Wide 1536x1024 presentation canvas, plain very light cool gray #F7F9FC background used only as the presentation surface. Navy #243C58 and restrained muted mint #79ADA3, no red, gold, gradient, shadow, mockup objects, embossed effects or watermark. Generous whitespace, precise alignment and professional Cyrillic typography. Main horizontal logo centered at generous size in the upper-middle. Beneath, show the SAME logo in a small single-color navy reproduction to demonstrate website-header legibility, separated by ample whitespace. No explanatory text, no slogans, no unnecessary decoration. Concept 01: refined geographic brand continuity. On the left, a compact highly simplified thin-line outline of Russia, recognizable geographic silhouette but without tiny islands, internal borders or jagged detail. It must read as one calm uncluttered symbol, NOT a frame around the name. To its right, the exact name 'Все Экспертизы' in an elegant restrained contemporary serif with sturdy strokes, and 'РФ' in small beautifully spaced sans-serif on a second line aligned with text left edge. Keep 'Все' and 'Экспертизы' equally readable, with 'Экспертизы' dominant by word length. A tiny mint accent near the name may be used. No waves, swooshes, scales of justice or shield. Small top-left presentation label exactly '01 / ГЕОГРАФИЯ'.

Goal: laconic, credible, premium, businesslike, suitable for expert reports and a sophisticated website using serif headings and a navy/mint palette. Flat graphic design with crisp vector-like edges. On the left, a custom compact navy monogram built from the Cyrillic uppercase letters 'ЭР', visibly readable as Э and Р, intelligently integrated with shared vertical structure and balanced negative space; sophisticated restrained serif geometry, no heraldic shield or circle frame.
